'''Zetan Wastes''' was an undisclosed location, which [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] used for his cover story in order to slip off the radar of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
